description.value:
You learn more complex flavors. The following beverages join your Mystic Brew options.

Blue Lightning. Whenever you take a Reaction that isn't an Opportunity Attack or a spell, you can make one Unarmed Strike as part of it.

Drunkard's Luck. You gain Heroic Inspiration if you don't already have it. In addition, you can give yourself Heroic Inspiration when you make an ability check or saving throw without it.

Stumbling Monk. When you take a Bonus Action other than Patient Defense, you can also use Patient Defense immediately after it.
